Use case: stylized-concept. Create a genuine 2D arcade game sprite animation atlas with TRUE TRANSPARENT ALPHA, no background or scene. Reference sheet contains five different people: use ONLY the FIFTH RIGHTMOST CHARACTER as identity/outfit/weapon reference, never the other four people. Retain that character's face, build, plain historically grounded Sengoku cloth/armor and helmet and palette exactly. Traditional detailed hand-painted 2D beat-em-up style, full body side / slight three-quarter view facing RIGHT, strong ink contour. Layout EXACTLY SIX columns by FOUR rows = 24 separately drawn chronological animation poses. No labels, text, gridlines, shadows, smoke, light streaks or decorative effects. Each invisible cell same size; each full figure and FULL weapon must fit wholly inside its OWN cell with at least20% blank transparent margin, shrink all figures equally to make long weapon fit. Never any overlap, touch, clipping, weapon point entering adjacent cell, duplicate pose or missing cell. Every chronological frame has incremental distinct arm/leg/weapon movement; body, head, armor proportions remain stable. Standing body scale equal in all24 cells; fixed soles floor within eachrow. Steel weapons ordinary gray, no glow/no blue or energy blade. Row0 SIX FRAME WALK CYCLE, alternating legs: right contact, right down, pass, left contact, left down, opposite pass. Attack rows each SIX frames: ready, windup1, windup2, impact extension, followthrough, recovery. Frames4-5 not repeats. 
Identity: darkblue armor and cloth, youthful male naginata warrior.
Row1 broad waist-high naginata sweep.
Row2 straight forward naginata thrust.
Row3 cross-shaft parry then sharp riposte cut.
Exactly24 complete separated poses, nothing else. Never draw the other4 people. Preserve reference identity; no extra luxury armor.
